description: The canonical normalized attendance record for one worker in one client/branch cycle. Emitted by the Logistay ingestion layer as the MERGE of a client artifact and a supervisor artifact, with per-field provenance. Attendance only — rates, pay and VAT are joined downstream by the rate-card and reconciliation engines, never stored here.

fields.description: The client × branch × cycle this line belongs to.
fields.label: Timesheet Period

fields.description: The worker this attendance is for. Real PII stored internally; sanitized only at export.
fields.label: Worker

fields.description: Role / package key as it appeared on the source sheet. The rate is joined later by the rate-card engine; it is NOT on the source timesheet.
fields.label: Role / Package

fields.description: COMPLETE lines are the sole input to reconciliation. A line with any open GATE data-quality flag stays INCOMPLETE and does not proceed.
fields.label: Completeness

fields.description: Delivery-line KPIs only. Blank for cleaning / security lines.
fields.label: Delivery KPIs

fields.description: Count of days a late arrival of 30 minutes or more was recorded (penalty-day counter).
fields.label: Late >= 30 min Days

fields.description: Count of late DEPARTURES, distinct from late arrivals. Feeds the departure-late threshold in the rate-card and reconciliation engines.
fields.label: Late Departure Count

fields.description: Set when the worker fell below the monthly target-day threshold.
fields.label: Under Target Flag

fields.description: Per-day canonical status codes for this cycle (1..31).
fields.label: Daily Status

fields.description: Field-level provenance: which source and which user supplied each canonical field. The dispute defence — never overwritten silently.
fields.label: Field Provenance

name: Timesheet Line
